title: Tele-MANAS (National Tele Mental Health Programme)
languages: Multiple Indian languages (20 named by the Health Ministry)
summary: A free, round-the-clock mental health helpline run by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. Callers can choose their language and speak to trained counsellors.
source_title: Two years of Tele MANAS (PIB, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare)

title: KIRAN mental health rehabilitation helpline
summary: A toll-free helpline from the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment offering early screening, first-aid psychological support, distress management and referral.
source_title: 24x7 Toll-Free Mental Health Rehabilitation Helpline Kiran launched in 13 languages (PIB)

title: iCALL psychosocial helpline (TISS)
hours: Monday to Saturday, 10 am to 8 pm (check the official page; timings have changed over time)
summary: A counselling service run by trained mental health professionals at the Tata Institute of Social Sciences by phone, email and chat.
source_title: iCALL telephonic counselling service (TISS project page)

title: CHILDLINE 1098
audience: Children and anyone concerned for a child in need of care or protection
summary: India's free emergency phone service for children in need of aid and protection, supported by the Ministry of Women and Child Development.

title: 112 India emergency number
audience: Anyone in danger or needing police, fire or ambulance help
summary: India's single emergency number for police, fire, ambulance and other emergencies, reachable by call, SMS, email, panic button and the 112 India app.
source_title: About the Emergency Response Support System

title: National cyber crime helpline 1930 and reporting portal
summary: For online financial fraud, call 1930 straight away and also file a complaint at cybercrime.gov.in. Keep screenshots, UPI IDs and receipts. Quick reporting helps stop the money moving.
source_title: National Cyber Crime Reporting Helpline No 1930

title: National Anti-Ragging Helpline (UGC)
summary: A 24x7 toll-free helpline under the UGC's National Ragging Prevention Programme for students facing ragging. Email helpline@antiragging.in.
source_title: Anti-Ragging Help Lines (NIT Kurukshetra, quoting the UGC helpline)

title: SHe-Box: workplace sexual harassment complaints
summary: The Ministry of Women and Child Development's portal to register a workplace sexual harassment complaint. It forwards the complaint to the right Internal or Local Committee.
source_title: Union Minister launches new SHe-Box Portal (PIB, 29 Aug 2024)

title: NALSA free legal aid helpline
audience: Anyone who needs free legal aid
summary: The National Legal Services Authority's toll-free helpline for free legal advice, legal aid applications and case status. Eligibility rules apply.

title: National Consumer Helpline
hours: 8 AM to 8 PM (per the helpline site)
summary: Register consumer complaints, for example about a coaching centre, a refund or an online purchase, by phone, WhatsApp or the web portal.
source_title: National Consumer Helpline Convergence Programme (Department of Consumer Affairs)

title: Women Helpline 181
summary: The national helpline for women in distress, listed in the government's directory of helplines.
